title.rendered: Gold prices remain unchanged at Rs437,836 per tola

content.rendered:
ISLAMABAD, Oct 15 (APP): Gold prices remained unchanged in the local market on Thursday, with the price of 24-karat gold per tola standing at Rs437,836, according to rates issued by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association.
Similarly, the price of 10 grams of 24-karat gold remained unchanged at Rs375,373, while 10 grams of 22-karat gold stood at Rs344,104.
In the international market, the price of gold remained unchanged at $4,153 per ounce, the association reported.
Meanwhile, the price of silver per tola decreased by Rs212 to Rs6,148, while the price of 10 grams of silver fell by Rs182 to Rs5,270.
The price of silver in the international market also declined by $2.12 to $56.70 per ounce, the association added.
